```{r setup-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# FIX E: load every package this notebook uses. Previously the only library()
# call was purrr, at the very end -- so a clean session failed immediately.
library(haven)      # read_dta
library(readr)      # read_csv / write_csv
library(dplyr)      # transmute, mutate, joins, case_when, ...
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(mice)       # make.method, make.predictorMatrix, mice, complete
library(lattice)    # densityplot / stripplot in the MICE diagnostics

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the REPOSITORY ROOT, not to code/.
#
# RStudio runs .Rmd chunks with the working directory set to the notebook's own
# folder, so without this the code would look for code/data/ instead of data/.
# The root is resolved into a variable rather than with setwd(), because a
# setwd() inside a chunk does not persist to the next chunk.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
repo_root <- if (basename(getwd()) == "code") normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
cat("Repository root:", repo_root, "\n")

# Shared output location -- MUST match `data_dir` in HRS_analysis.Rmd so the
# analysis notebook reads exactly what this notebook writes.
data_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "data")
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#hrs summary data 
hrs_2022summary <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/randhrs1992_2022v1_STATA/randhrs1992_2022v1.dta")
hrs_2022summary <- read_dta(hrs_2022summary)

#hrs LangaWeir data 
hrs_LangaWeir <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/LangaWeir2022v1/cogfinalimp_9522wide.dta")
hrs_LangaWeir <- read_dta(hrs_LangaWeir)

# hrs Track data
hrs_Track <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/trk2022v1/trk2022tr_r.csv")
hrs_Track <- read_csv(hrs_Track)

# ---- Determine death events from the HRS Tracker ------------------------
# died == 1 iff a death YEAR can be established from any tracker source.
#
# Sources, in priority order:
#   1. KNOWNDECEASED* with SOURCE 1-3 : observed death date (exit interview,
#      spouse core interview, or field report)
#   2. N* (NYEAR/NMONTH)              : National Death Index linkage
#   3. KNOWNDECEASED* with SOURCE 4   : HRS-imputed date, last resort
#
# Year and month are taken TOGETHER from the first source supplying a year,
# so a date is never assembled from two different sources.
#
# NOTE: NMONTH is a calendar QUARTER (1=Jan-Mar ... 4=Oct-Dec) in the public
# release, NOT a month. It is mapped to the mid-quarter month before use.
# EXDEATH* is omitted: it is a strict subset of KNOWNDECEASED* sources 1-2
# (17,299 + 188 = 17,487) and adds no cases.

death_track <- hrs_Track %>%
  transmute(
    # ID
    hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(HHID) + as.numeric(PN),

    # source-specific year/month, kept as pairs
    ky = as.numeric(KNOWNDECEASEDYR),
    km = as.numeric(KNOWNDECEASEDMO),
    ks = as.numeric(KNOWNDECEASEDSOURCE),
    ny = as.numeric(NYEAR),
    nq = as.numeric(NMONTH),          # QUARTER, not month

    # Last observed alive
    lastalive_year  = as.numeric(LASTALIVEYR),
    lastalive_month = as.numeric(LASTALIVEMO)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # NDI quarter -> mid-quarter month (1->2, 2->5, 3->8, 4->11)
    nm = 3 * nq - 1,

    # KD date is observed unless source 4 (imputed from last-alive date and
    # the date HRS learned the respondent had died)
    kd_observed = !is.na(ky) & ks %in% 1:3,

    death_year = case_when(
      kd_observed ~ ky,
      !is.na(ny)  ~ ny,
      !is.na(ky)  ~ ky,
      TRUE        ~ NA_real_
    ),
    death_month = case_when(
      kd_observed ~ km,
      !is.na(ny)  ~ nm,
      !is.na(ky)  ~ km,
      TRUE        ~ NA_real_
    ),
    death_src = case_when(
      kd_observed ~ "known_observed",
      !is.na(ny)  ~ "ndi",
      !is.na(ky)  ~ "known_imputed",
      TRUE        ~ NA_character_
    ),

    died = if_else(!is.na(death_year), 1L, 0L),

    # fill missing month with mid-year ONLY when a death year exists
    death_month = if_else(is.na(death_month) & !is.na(death_year), 6, death_month),
    lastalive_month = if_else(is.na(lastalive_month) & !is.na(lastalive_year),
                              6, lastalive_month),

    # flag deaths dated before the last known-alive date (n = 93)
    date_conflict = died == 1 &
      (death_year + (death_month - 1) / 12) <
      (lastalive_year + (lastalive_month - 1) / 12)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, death_year, death_month, death_src,
                lastalive_year, lastalive_month, died, date_conflict)

# Quick look at how many death events were established
cat("Death events determined from tracker:\n")
cat("  individuals in tracker :", nrow(death_track), "\n")
cat("  died == 1              :", sum(death_track$died == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  death-year range       :",
    paste(range(death_track$death_year, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-"), "\n")
```

# HRS database
# choose 2004 as baseline start-point
```{r}
# hrs data 2004
df_3 <- hrs_2022summary
wave <- 7        # 2004
year <- 2004L

nm_3 <- setNames(names(df_3), toupper(names(df_3)))

id_var_3    <- nm_3["HHIDPN"]
byear_var_3 <- nm_3["RABYEAR"]
bmon_var_3  <- nm_3["RABMONTH"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_3, byear_var_3, bmon_var_3))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2004).")

cov_req_2004 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R7AGEY_E",     # RAND-calculated age at end of interview month
  "R7MSTAT",
  "R7WORK",
  "R7SMOKEN",
  "R7DRINKD",
  "R7VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2004 <- nm_3[toupper(cov_req_2004)]
cov_actual_2004 <- cov_actual_2004[!is.na(cov_actual_2004)]

hrs_cov_2004 <- df_3 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn      = .data[[id_var_3]],
    year        = year,
    birth_year  = .data[[byear_var_3]],
    birth_month = .data[[bmon_var_3]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2004))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Prefer RAND's interview-date-aware age; fall back to year - birth_year.
    age_2004 = coalesce(as.numeric(R7AGEY_E), year - birth_year),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # 0 = Less than HS; 1 = HS or GED (RAEDUC 2 or 3); 2 = post-HS (4 or 5).
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,
      TRUE                ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # 1 = married / partnered / spouse-absent (codes 1, 2, 3 per RAND);
    # 0 = separated / divorced / widowed / never married.
    Marital_status = case_when(
      R7MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R7MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R7WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R7WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R7SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R7SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R7DRINKD > 0  ~ 1L,
      R7DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # 0 = Non-Hispanic White; 1 = Hispanic OR Non-Hispanic (Black / Other).
    # When RAHISPAN is missing but race is White, treat as Non-Hispanic White
    # (recovers cases that would otherwise be dropped to NA).
    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)             ~ 1L,
      TRUE                                             ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R7VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R7VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2004,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )

# dementia (Langa-Weir 2004)
lw_2004 <- hrs_LangaWeir %>%
  filter(interview2004 == 1) %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(hhid) + as.numeric(pn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    year = 2004L,
    cogfunction = cogfunction2004,
    cogtot27    = cogtot27_imp2004
  )
```

# FAT 2004 file (UPDATE PATH to your 2004 file)
```{r}
# FAT 2004 file
fat_path_04 <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/h04f1c_STATA/h04f1c.dta")

fat04 <- read_dta(
  fat_path_04,
  col_select = c(hhidpn,
                 jc104, jc087,                              # pain, incontinence
                 jc095, jc096, jc097, jc098, jc101, jc102, jc103,  # sensory 
                 jg086, jb082, jg198))                      # social activity

## Pain & incontinence
fat_pain_incont_2004 <- fat04 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    pain_2004 = case_when(
      jc104 == 1 ~ 1,
      jc104 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    incont_2004 = case_when(
      jc087 == 1 ~ 1,
      jc087 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Sensory (FAT) — hearing_aid removed; skip-patterns handled
sensory_2004 <- fat04 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      jc103 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      jc103 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hearing_aid = case_when(
      jc102 == 1         ~ 1L,
      jc102 == 5         ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_overall = case_when(
      jc095 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      jc095 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,    # 6 = Legally Blind → impaired
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # Legally blind (jc095==6) → impaired for far/near (not asked)
    vision_far = case_when(
      jc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      jc096 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      jc096 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_near = case_when(
      jc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      jc097 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      jc097 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # Skip-pattern: NaN means condition not diagnosed → 0
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      jc098 == 1         ~ 1L,
      jc098 == 5         ~ 0L,
      jc098 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(jc098)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    glaucoma_treatment = case_when(
      jc101 == 1         ~ 1L,
      jc101 == 5         ~ 0L,
      jc101 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(jc101)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Social activity (FAT)
social_2004 <- fat04 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    volunteer = case_when(
      jg086 == 1 ~ 1L,
      jg086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      jb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,    # >= monthly attendance
      jb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      jg198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      jg198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index
fi_stems <- c(
  "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
  "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
  "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS",
  "HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART","STROK",
  "SHLT",
  "SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING",
  "ENLIFE",
  "BMI"
)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
iadl_stems <- c(
  "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",   # ADL
  "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"         # IADL
)

prefix <- paste0("R", wave)

fi_vars_req_2004    <- paste0("R", wave, fi_stems)
fi_vars_actual_2004 <- nm_3[fi_vars_req_2004]
fi_vars_actual_2004 <- fi_vars_actual_2004[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2004)]

hrs_fi_2004 <- df_3 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = .data[[id_var_3]],
    across(all_of(fi_vars_actual_2004))     # named vector → renames to uppercase keys
  )

hrs_fi_04 <- hrs_fi_2004 %>%
  mutate(
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility: 0=no, 1=yes (deficit), 2=can't do (deficit), 7=don't do (treat as deficit)
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0           ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2004 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_04 <- hrs_fi_04 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2004, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2004 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_04), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2004 <- length(fi_items_2004)
cutoff_2004  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2004)

hrs_fi_04_valid <- hrs_fi_04 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2004))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2004) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2004)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2004_orig <- hrs_fi_04_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2004 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2004_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2004, iadl_vars_2004)

n_items_2004_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2004_noIADL)
cutoff_2004_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2004_noIADL)

hrs_fi_04_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_04 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2004_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2004_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2004_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2004_noIADL <- hrs_fi_04_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2004_final <- hrs_fi_2004_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2004_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")
    
```




```{r}
# 6. Merge 2004 data
hrs_2004 <- hrs_cov_2004 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2004,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2004,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2004 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2004_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2004,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))

# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
# ---- 1. Prepare dataset for imputation -----------------------------
# FIX (specification): FI_score, Frailty_status and dementia were carried here
# as "auxiliary predictors" with method "" while remaining in the predictor
# matrix. mice never fills the missing cells of a non-imputed variable, so
# their NAs were entering the design matrix of every imputation model. They are
# removed rather than imputed: the Methods state that the primary study
# variables were not imputed, and waves 2006-2020 (and ELSA) never included
# them, so dropping them also makes 2004 consistent with every other wave.
# FI_score and Frailty_status were additionally collinear by construction.
imp04 <- hrs_2004 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender    = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    age_2004  = as.numeric(age_2004),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race      = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# ---- 2. Quantify missingness (for methods text) --------------------
miss_pct <- sapply(imp04, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
miss_cov <- miss_pct[miss_pct > 0]
cat("Percentage missing per variable:\n"); print(round(miss_pct, 2))
if (length(miss_cov) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across covariates: %.2f%%\n", mean(miss_cov)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov), names(which.max(miss_cov))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 3. Imputation method per variable -----------------------------
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race are now imputed INSIDE the fully
# conditional specification so that no predictor carries NAs into the design
# matrix. They are NOT carried back into the analysis data -- vars_imputed
# below excludes them -- so hrs_2004 retains its original Gender and Race,
# including missing values (this preserves the missing-race count in Table 1).
meth <- make.method(imp04)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2004"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp04)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 4. Predictor matrix: all other covariates as predictors -------
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp04)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0   # ID is never a predictor
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0   # ID is never imputed

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete04 <- names(imp04)[colSums(is.na(imp04)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete04] != ""))

# ---- 5. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ---------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice04 <- mice(
  imp04,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

# Any logged event means mice silently altered the specification (e.g. dropped
# a collinear predictor) -- inspect rather than assume the spec above was used.
if (!is.null(imp_mice04$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (HRS 2004):\n")
  print(imp_mice04$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6. Convergence diagnostics ----
plot(imp_mice04)   # trace plot is safe — only includes imputed vars

# helper: does mice have enough imputed values to plot?
has_imps <- function(mids_obj, v) {
  !is.null(mids_obj$imp[[v]]) && nrow(mids_obj$imp[[v]]) >= 2
}

# ---- 7. Compare imputed vs observed (continuous) ----
if (has_imps(imp_mice04, "age_2004")) {
  print(densityplot(imp_mice04, ~ age_2004))
  print(stripplot(imp_mice04, age_2004 ~ .imp, pch = 20, cex = 1.2))
} else {
  message(sprintf("age_2004: only %d missing value(s) — density/strip plots skipped.",
                  sum(is.na(imp_mice04$data$age_2004))))
}

# Numerical summaries: observed vs imputed for each variable
compare_summaries <- function(mids_obj, var) {
  orig <- mids_obj$data[[var]]
  imps <- lapply(seq_len(mids_obj$m),
                 function(i) complete(mids_obj, i)[[var]])
  if (is.numeric(orig)) {
    obs_mean  <- mean(orig, na.rm = TRUE)
    imp_means <- sapply(imps, mean)
    data.frame(variable = var,
               observed_mean    = round(obs_mean, 3),
               imputed_mean_min = round(min(imp_means), 3),
               imputed_mean_max = round(max(imp_means), 3))
  } else {
    obs_tab <- prop.table(table(as.character(orig)))
    imp_tab <- prop.table(table(unlist(lapply(imps, as.character))))
    data.frame(variable = var,
               observed = paste(names(obs_tab), round(obs_tab, 3),
                                sep = "=", collapse = " | "),
               imputed  = paste(names(imp_tab), round(imp_tab, 3),
                                sep = "=", collapse = " | "))
  }
}

vars_imputed <- c("age_2004", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                  "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")
diag_tables  <- lapply(vars_imputed, compare_summaries, mids_obj = imp_mice04)
print(diag_tables)

# ---- 8. Extract ONE completed dataset (consistent with 2006-2020 waves) ----
# FIX: previously this pulled complete(imp_mice04, action = "long") and kept
# .imp/.id all the way into HRS_2004, giving every 2004 person 20 rows while
# every other wave has 1. mice() above still runs m = 20 so the convergence
# and density/strip-plot diagnostics above stay valid -- we just now take a
# single completed dataset (imputation #1), matching 2006-2020 exactly.
imp04_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice04, 1)

hrs04_clean <- hrs_2004 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(vars_imputed)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp04_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(vars_imputed)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )

# 9. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2004 <- hrs04_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# hrs data 2006
df_4 <- hrs_2022summary
wave <- 8      # 2006
year <- 2006L

nm_4 <- setNames(names(df_4), toupper(names(df_4)))

id_var_4    <- nm_4["HHIDPN"]
byear_var_4 <- nm_4["RABYEAR"]
bmon_var_4  <- nm_4["RABMONTH"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_4, byear_var_4, bmon_var_4))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2006).")

cov_req_2006 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R8AGEY_E",       # end-of-wave age (precise)
  "R8MSTAT",
  "R8WORK",
  "R8SMOKEN",
  "R8DRINKD",
  "R8VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2006 <- nm_4[toupper(cov_req_2006)]
cov_actual_2006 <- cov_actual_2006[!is.na(cov_actual_2006)]

hrs_cov_2006 <- df_4 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn      = .data[[id_var_4]],
    year        = year,
    birth_year  = .data[[ byear_var_4 ]],
    birth_month = .data[[ bmon_var_4 ]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2006))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # FIX: prefer R8AGEY_E; fall back to year - birth_year
    age_2006 = coalesce(
      as.numeric(R8AGEY_E),
      if_else(!is.na(birth_year), as.numeric(year - birth_year), NA_real_)
    ),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: HS grad (3) belongs with HS tier, not college
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,    # < HS
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,    # GED + HS grad
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,    # some college / college+
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: include partnered/spouse-absent (codes 2, 3) as married/partnered
    Marital_status = case_when(
      R8MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R8MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R8WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R8WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R8SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R8SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R8DRINKD >  0 ~ 1L,
      R8DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: NH White still classified when RAHISPAN missing
    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R8VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R8VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2006,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )

# dementia (Langa-Weir 2006)
lw_2006 <- hrs_LangaWeir %>%
  filter(interview2006 == 1) %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(hhid) + as.numeric(pn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    year        = 2006L,
    cogfunction = cogfunction2006,
    cogtot27    = cogtot27_imp2006
  )
```

```{r}
# FAT 2006 file
fat_path_06 <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/h06f4b_STATA/h06f4b.dta")

fat06 <- read_dta(
  fat_path_06,
  col_select = c(hhidpn,
                 kc104, kc087,                                     # pain, incontinence
                 kc095, kc096, kc097, kc098, kc101, kc102, kc103,  # sensory (incl. hearing_aid)
                 kg086, kb082, kg198))                              # social activity

## Pain & incontinence
fat_pain_incont_2006 <- fat06 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    pain_2006 = case_when(
      kc104 == 1 ~ 1,
      kc104 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    incont_2006 = case_when(
      kc087 == 1 ~ 1,
      kc087 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Sensory (FAT) — hearing_aid kept; skip-patterns handled
sensory_2006 <- fat06 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      kc103 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      kc103 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hearing_aid = case_when(
      kc102 == 1         ~ 1L,
      kc102 == 5         ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_overall = case_when(
      kc095 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      kc095 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,    # 6 = Legally Blind → impaired
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: legally blind (kc095==6) → impaired for far/near (skip-coded)
    vision_far = case_when(
      kc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      kc096 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      kc096 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_near = case_when(
      kc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      kc097 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      kc097 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: skip-pattern (no diagnosis) NaN → 0
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      kc098 == 1         ~ 1L,
      kc098 == 5         ~ 0L,
      kc098 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(kc098)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    glaucoma_treatment = case_when(
      kc101 == 1         ~ 1L,
      kc101 == 5         ~ 0L,
      kc101 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(kc101)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Social activity (FAT)
social_2006 <- fat06 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    volunteer = case_when(
      kg086 == 1 ~ 1L,
      kg086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      kb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      kb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      kg198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      kg198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index
fi_vars_req_2006    <- paste0("R", wave, fi_stems)
fi_vars_actual_2006 <- nm_4[fi_vars_req_2006]
fi_vars_actual_2006 <- fi_vars_actual_2006[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2006)]

hrs_fi_2006 <- df_4 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = .data[[id_var_4]],
    across(all_of(fi_vars_actual_2006))     # named vector → renames to uppercase keys
  )

prefix <- paste0("R", wave)

hrs_fi_06 <- hrs_fi_2006 %>%
  mutate(
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility — code 7 ("don't do") treated as deficit
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0            ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4)    ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2006 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_06 <- hrs_fi_06 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2006, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2006 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_06), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2006 <- length(fi_items_2006)
cutoff_2006  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2006)

hrs_fi_06_valid <- hrs_fi_06 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2006))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2006) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2006)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2006_orig <- hrs_fi_06_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Same ≥0.25 threshold and ≥80% completeness rule, reapplied
#     to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2006 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2006_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2006, iadl_vars_2006)

n_items_2006_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2006_noIADL)
cutoff_2006_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2006_noIADL)

hrs_fi_06_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_06 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2006_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2006_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2006_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2006_noIADL <- hrs_fi_06_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2006_final <- hrs_fi_2006_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2006_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")
```

```{r}
# 6. Merge 2006 data
hrs_2006 <- hrs_cov_2006 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2006,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2006,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2006 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2006_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2006,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))


# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
imp06 <- hrs_2006 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender,
    age_2006 = as.numeric(age_2006),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity,
             Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)))

# Define imputation methods
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race previously had method "" while remaining
# in the predictor matrix, so mice never filled their missing cells and NAs were
# fed into every imputation model. They are now imputed INSIDE the FCS but are
# NOT carried back (imputed_vars below excludes them), so the analysis data
# keeps its original Gender and Race, including missing values.
meth <- make.method(imp06)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2006"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp06)) == 0] <- ""

# Predictor matrix
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp06)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete06 <- names(imp06)[colSums(is.na(imp06)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete06] != ""))

# Run MICE
set.seed(6)
imp_mice06 <- mice(
  imp06,
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp06_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice06, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2006")

hrs06_clean <- hrs_2006 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp06_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2006 <- hrs06_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
      lg086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      lb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      lb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      lg198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      lg198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index
fi_vars_req_2008    <- paste0("R", wave, fi_stems)
fi_vars_actual_2008 <- nm_5[fi_vars_req_2008]
fi_vars_actual_2008 <- fi_vars_actual_2008[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2008)]

hrs_fi_2008 <- df_5 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = .data[[id_var_5]],
    across(all_of(fi_vars_actual_2008))     # named vector → renames to uppercase keys
  )

prefix <- paste0("R", wave)

hrs_fi_08 <- hrs_fi_2008 %>%
  mutate(
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility — code 7 ("don't do") treated as deficit
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0            ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4)    ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2008 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_08 <- hrs_fi_08 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2008, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2008 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_08), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2008 <- length(fi_items_2008)
cutoff_2008  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2008)

hrs_fi_08_valid <- hrs_fi_08 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2008))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2008) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2008)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2008_orig <- hrs_fi_08_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Same ≥0.25 threshold and ≥80% completeness rule, reapplied
#     to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2008 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2008_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2008, iadl_vars_2008)

n_items_2008_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2008_noIADL)
cutoff_2008_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2008_noIADL)

hrs_fi_08_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_08 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2008_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2008_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2008_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2008_noIADL <- hrs_fi_08_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2008_final <- hrs_fi_2008_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2008_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")
```

```{r}
# 6. Merge 2008 data
hrs_2008 <- hrs_cov_2008 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2008,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2008,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2008 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2008_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2008,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))


# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
imp08 <- hrs_2008 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender,
    age_2008 = as.numeric(age_2008),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity,
             Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)))

# Define imputation methods
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race previously had method "" while remaining
# in the predictor matrix, so mice never filled their missing cells and NAs were
# fed into every imputation model. They are now imputed INSIDE the FCS but are
# NOT carried back (imputed_vars below excludes them), so the analysis data
# keeps its original Gender and Race, including missing values.
meth <- make.method(imp08)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2008"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp08)) == 0] <- ""

# Predictor matrix
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp08)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete08 <- names(imp08)[colSums(is.na(imp08)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete08] != ""))

# Run MICE
set.seed(8)
imp_mice08 <- mice(
  imp08,
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp08_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice08, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2008")

hrs08_clean <- hrs_2008 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp08_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2008 <- hrs08_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# HRS data 2010 (Wave 10)
df_6 <- hrs_2022summary
wave <- 10
year <- 2010L

nm_6 <- setNames(names(df_6), toupper(names(df_6)))

id_var_6    <- nm_6["HHIDPN"]
byear_var_6 <- nm_6["RABYEAR"]
bmon_var_6  <- nm_6["RABMONTH"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_6, byear_var_6, bmon_var_6))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2010).")

cov_req_2010 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R10AGEY_E",       # end-of-wave age (precise)
  "R10MSTAT",
  "R10WORK",
  "R10SMOKEN",
  "R10DRINKD",
  "R10VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2010 <- nm_6[toupper(cov_req_2010)]
cov_actual_2010 <- cov_actual_2010[!is.na(cov_actual_2010)]

hrs_cov_2010 <- df_6 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn      = .data[[id_var_6]],
    year        = year,
    birth_year  = .data[[ byear_var_6 ]],
    birth_month = .data[[ bmon_var_6 ]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2010))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # FIX: prefer R10AGEY_E; fall back to year - birth_year
    age_2010 = coalesce(
      as.numeric(R10AGEY_E),
      if_else(!is.na(birth_year), as.numeric(year - birth_year), NA_real_)
    ),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: HS grad (3) belongs with HS tier, not college
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: include partnered/spouse-absent (codes 2, 3) as married/partnered
    Marital_status = case_when(
      R10MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R10MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R10WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R10WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R10SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R10SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R10DRINKD >  0 ~ 1L,
      R10DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: NH White still classified when RAHISPAN missing
    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R10VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R10VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2010,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )

# dementia (Langa-Weir 2010)
lw_2010 <- hrs_LangaWeir %>%
  filter(interview2010 == 1) %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(hhid) + as.numeric(pn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    year        = 2010L,
    cogfunction = cogfunction2010,
    cogtot27    = cogtot27_imp2010
  )
```

```{r}
# FAT 2010 file
fat_path_10 <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/hd10f6b_STATA/hd10f6b.dta")

fat10 <- read_dta(
  fat_path_10,
  col_select = c(hhidpn,
                 mc104, mc087,                                     # pain, incontinence
                 mc095, mc096, mc097, mc098, mc101, mc102, mc103,  # sensory (incl. hearing_aid)
                 mg086, mb082, mg198))                              # social activity

## Pain & incontinence
fat_pain_incont_2010 <- fat10 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    pain_2010 = case_when(
      mc104 == 1 ~ 1,
      mc104 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    incont_2010 = case_when(
      mc087 == 1 ~ 1,
      mc087 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Sensory (FAT) — hearing_aid kept; skip-patterns handled
sensory_2010 <- fat10 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      mc103 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      mc103 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hearing_aid = case_when(
      mc102 == 1         ~ 1L,
      mc102 == 5         ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_overall = case_when(
      mc095 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      mc095 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,    # 6 = Legally Blind → impaired
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: legally blind (mc095==6) → impaired for far/near (skip-coded)
    vision_far = case_when(
      mc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      mc096 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      mc096 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_near = case_when(
      mc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      mc097 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      mc097 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: skip-pattern (no diagnosis) NaN → 0
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      mc098 == 1         ~ 1L,
      mc098 == 5         ~ 0L,
      mc098 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(mc098)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    glaucoma_treatment = case_when(
      mc101 == 1         ~ 1L,
      mc101 == 5         ~ 0L,
      mc101 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(mc101)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Social activity (FAT)
social_2010 <- fat10 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    volunteer = case_when(
      mg086 == 1 ~ 1L,
      mg086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      mb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      mb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      mg198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      mg198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index
```

```{r}
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp10_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice10, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2010")

hrs10_clean <- hrs_2010 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp10_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2010 <- hrs10_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# HRS data 2012 (Wave 11)
df_7 <- hrs_2022summary
wave <- 11
year <- 2012L

nm_7 <- setNames(names(df_7), toupper(names(df_7)))

id_var_7    <- nm_7["HHIDPN"]
byear_var_7 <- nm_7["RABYEAR"]
bmon_var_7  <- nm_7["RABMONTH"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_7, byear_var_7, bmon_var_7))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2012).")

cov_req_2012 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R11AGEY_E",       # end-of-wave age (precise)
  "R11MSTAT",
  "R11WORK",
  "R11SMOKEN",
  "R11DRINKD",
  "R11VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2012 <- nm_7[toupper(cov_req_2012)]
cov_actual_2012 <- cov_actual_2012[!is.na(cov_actual_2012)]

hrs_cov_2012 <- df_7 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn      = .data[[id_var_7]],
    year        = year,
    birth_year  = .data[[ byear_var_7 ]],
    birth_month = .data[[ bmon_var_7 ]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2012))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # FIX: prefer R11AGEY_E; fall back to year - birth_year
    age_2012 = coalesce(
      as.numeric(R11AGEY_E),
      if_else(!is.na(birth_year), as.numeric(year - birth_year), NA_real_)
    ),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: HS grad (3) belongs with HS tier, not college
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: include partnered/spouse-absent (codes 2, 3) as married/partnered
    Marital_status = case_when(
      R11MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R11MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R11WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R11WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R11SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R11SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R11DRINKD >  0 ~ 1L,
      R11DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: NH White still classified when RAHISPAN missing
    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R11VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R11VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2012,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )

# dementia (Langa-Weir 2012)
lw_2012 <- hrs_LangaWeir %>%
  filter(interview2012 == 1) %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(hhid) + as.numeric(pn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    year        = 2012L,
    cogfunction = cogfunction2012,
    cogtot27    = cogtot27_imp2012
  )
```

```{r}
# FAT 2012 file
fat_path_12 <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/h12f3a_STATA/h12f3a.dta")

fat12 <- read_dta(
  fat_path_12,
  col_select = c(hhidpn,
                 nc104, nc087,                                     # pain, incontinence
                 nc095, nc096, nc097, nc098, nc101, nc102, nc103,  # sensory (incl. hearing_aid)
                 ng086, nb082, ng198))                              # social activity

## Pain & incontinence
fat_pain_incont_2012 <- fat12 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    pain_2012 = case_when(
      nc104 == 1 ~ 1,
      nc104 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    incont_2012 = case_when(
      nc087 == 1 ~ 1,
      nc087 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Sensory (FAT) — hearing_aid kept; skip-patterns handled
sensory_2012 <- fat12 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      nc103 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      nc103 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hearing_aid = case_when(
      nc102 == 1         ~ 1L,
      nc102 == 5         ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_overall = case_when(
      nc095 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      nc095 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,    # 6 = Legally Blind → impaired
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: legally blind (nc095==6) → impaired for far/near (skip-coded)
    vision_far = case_when(
      nc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      nc096 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      nc096 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_near = case_when(
      nc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      nc097 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      nc097 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: skip-pattern (no diagnosis) NaN → 0
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      nc098 == 1         ~ 1L,
      nc098 == 5         ~ 0L,
      nc098 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(nc098)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    glaucoma_treatment = case_when(
      nc101 == 1         ~ 1L,
      nc101 == 5         ~ 0L,
      nc101 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(nc101)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Social activity (FAT)
social_2012 <- fat12 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    volunteer = case_when(
      ng086 == 1 ~ 1L,
      ng086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      nb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      nb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      ng198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      ng198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index
fi_vars_req_2012    <- paste0("R", wave, fi_stems)
fi_vars_actual_2012 <- nm_7[fi_vars_req_2012]
fi_vars_actual_2012 <- fi_vars_actual_2012[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2012)]

hrs_fi_2012 <- df_7 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = .data[[id_var_7]],
    across(all_of(fi_vars_actual_2012))     # named vector → renames to uppercase keys
  )

prefix <- paste0("R", wave)

hrs_fi_12 <- hrs_fi_2012 %>%
  mutate(
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility — code 7 ("don't do") treated as deficit
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0            ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4)    ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2012 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_12 <- hrs_fi_12 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2012, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2012 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_12), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2012 <- length(fi_items_2012)
cutoff_2012  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2012)

hrs_fi_12_valid <- hrs_fi_12 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2012))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2012) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2012)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2012_orig <- hrs_fi_12_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Same ≥0.25 threshold and ≥80% completeness rule, reapplied
#     to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2012 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2012_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2012, iadl_vars_2012)

n_items_2012_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2012_noIADL)
cutoff_2012_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2012_noIADL)

hrs_fi_12_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_12 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2012_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2012_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2012_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2012_noIADL <- hrs_fi_12_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2012_final <- hrs_fi_2012_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2012_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")
```

```{r}
# 6. Merge 2012 data
hrs_2012 <- hrs_cov_2012 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2012,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2012,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2012 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2012_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2012,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))


# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
imp12 <- hrs_2012 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender,
    age_2012 = as.numeric(age_2012),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity,
             Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)))

# Define imputation methods
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race previously had method "" while remaining
# in the predictor matrix, so mice never filled their missing cells and NAs were
# fed into every imputation model. They are now imputed INSIDE the FCS but are
# NOT carried back (imputed_vars below excludes them), so the analysis data
# keeps its original Gender and Race, including missing values.
meth <- make.method(imp12)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2012"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp12)) == 0] <- ""

# Predictor matrix
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp12)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete12 <- names(imp12)[colSums(is.na(imp12)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete12] != ""))

# Run MICE
set.seed(12)
imp_mice12 <- mice(
  imp12,
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp12_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice12, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2012")

hrs12_clean <- hrs_2012 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp12_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2012 <- hrs12_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
fi_vars_actual_2014 <- nm_8[fi_vars_req_2014]
fi_vars_actual_2014 <- fi_vars_actual_2014[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2014)]

hrs_fi_2014 <- df_8 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = .data[[id_var_8]],
    across(all_of(fi_vars_actual_2014))     # named vector → renames to uppercase keys
  )

prefix <- paste0("R", wave)

hrs_fi_14 <- hrs_fi_2014 %>%
  mutate(
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility — code 7 ("don't do") treated as deficit
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0            ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4)    ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2014 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_14 <- hrs_fi_14 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2014, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2014 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_14), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2014 <- length(fi_items_2014)
cutoff_2014  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2014)

hrs_fi_14_valid <- hrs_fi_14 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2014))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2014) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2014)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2014_orig <- hrs_fi_14_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Same ≥0.25 threshold and ≥80% completeness rule, reapplied
#     to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2014 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2014_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2014, iadl_vars_2014)

n_items_2014_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2014_noIADL)
cutoff_2014_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2014_noIADL)

hrs_fi_14_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_14 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2014_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2014_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2014_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2014_noIADL <- hrs_fi_14_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2014_final <- hrs_fi_2014_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2014_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")
```

```{r}
# 6. Merge 2014 data
hrs_2014 <- hrs_cov_2014 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2014,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2014,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2014 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2014_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2014,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))


# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
imp14 <- hrs_2014 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender,
    age_2014 = as.numeric(age_2014),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity,
             Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)))

# Define imputation methods
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race previously had method "" while remaining
# in the predictor matrix, so mice never filled their missing cells and NAs were
# fed into every imputation model. They are now imputed INSIDE the FCS but are
# NOT carried back (imputed_vars below excludes them), so the analysis data
# keeps its original Gender and Race, including missing values.
meth <- make.method(imp14)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2014"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp14)) == 0] <- ""

# Predictor matrix
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp14)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete14 <- names(imp14)[colSums(is.na(imp14)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete14] != ""))

# Run MICE
set.seed(14)
imp_mice14 <- mice(
  imp14,
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp14_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice14, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2014")

hrs14_clean <- hrs_2014 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp14_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2014 <- hrs14_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# HRS data 2016 (Wave 13)
df_9 <- hrs_2022summary
wave <- 13
year <- 2016L

nm_9 <- setNames(names(df_9), toupper(names(df_9)))

id_var_9    <- nm_9["HHIDPN"]
byear_var_9 <- nm_9["RABYEAR"]
bmon_var_9  <- nm_9["RABMONTH"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_9, byear_var_9, bmon_var_9))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2016).")

cov_req_2016 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R13AGEY_E",       # end-of-wave age (precise)
  "R13MSTAT",
  "R13WORK",
  "R13SMOKEN",
  "R13DRINKD",
  "R13VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2016 <- nm_9[toupper(cov_req_2016)]
cov_actual_2016 <- cov_actual_2016[!is.na(cov_actual_2016)]

hrs_cov_2016 <- df_9 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn      = .data[[id_var_9]],
    year        = year,
    birth_year  = .data[[ byear_var_9 ]],
    birth_month = .data[[ bmon_var_9 ]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2016))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # FIX: prefer R13AGEY_E; fall back to year - birth_year
    age_2016 = coalesce(
      as.numeric(R13AGEY_E),
      if_else(!is.na(birth_year), as.numeric(year - birth_year), NA_real_)
    ),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: HS grad (3) belongs with HS tier, not college
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: include partnered/spouse-absent (codes 2, 3) as married/partnered
    Marital_status = case_when(
      R13MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R13MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R13WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R13WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R13SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R13SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R13DRINKD >  0 ~ 1L,
      R13DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: NH White still classified when RAHISPAN missing
    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R13VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R13VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2016,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )

# dementia (Langa-Weir 2016)
lw_2016 <- hrs_LangaWeir %>%
  filter(interview2016 == 1) %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(hhid) + as.numeric(pn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    year        = 2016L,
    cogfunction = cogfunction2016,
    cogtot27    = cogtot27_imp2016
  )
```

```{r}
# FAT 2016 file
fat_path_16 <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/h16f2c_STATA/h16f2c.dta")

fat16 <- read_dta(
  fat_path_16,
  col_select = c(hhidpn,
                 pc104, pc087,                                     # pain, incontinence
                 pc095, pc096, pc097, pc098, pc101, pc102, pc103,  # sensory (incl. hearing_aid)
                 pg086, pb082, pg198))                              # social activity

## Pain & incontinence
fat_pain_incont_2016 <- fat16 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    pain_2016 = case_when(
      pc104 == 1 ~ 1,
      pc104 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    incont_2016 = case_when(
      pc087 == 1 ~ 1,
      pc087 == 5 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Sensory (FAT) — hearing_aid kept; skip-patterns handled
sensory_2016 <- fat16 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      pc103 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      pc103 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hearing_aid = case_when(
      pc102 == 1         ~ 1L,
      pc102 == 5         ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_overall = case_when(
      pc095 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      pc095 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,    # 6 = Legally Blind → impaired
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: legally blind (pc095==6) → impaired for far/near (skip-coded)
    vision_far = case_when(
      pc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      pc096 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      pc096 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_near = case_when(
      pc095 == 6            ~ 1L,
      pc097 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      pc097 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # FIX: skip-pattern (no diagnosis) NaN → 0
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      pc098 == 1         ~ 1L,
      pc098 == 5         ~ 0L,
      pc098 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(pc098)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    glaucoma_treatment = case_when(
      pc101 == 1         ~ 1L,
      pc101 == 5         ~ 0L,
      pc101 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(pc101)       ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Social activity (FAT)
social_2016 <- fat16 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    volunteer = case_when(
      pg086 == 1 ~ 1L,
      pg086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      pb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      pb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      pg198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      pg198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index

fi_vars_actual_2016 <- fi_vars_actual_2016[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2016)]
```

```{r}
HRS_2016 <- hrs16_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# HRS data 2018 (Wave 14)
df_10 <- hrs_2022summary
wave <- 14
year <- 2018L

nm_10 <- setNames(names(df_10), toupper(names(df_10)))

id_var_10    <- nm_10["HHIDPN"]
byear_var_10 <- nm_10["RABYEAR"]
bmon_var_10  <- nm_10["RABMONTH"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_10, byear_var_10, bmon_var_10))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2018).")

cov_req_2018 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R14AGEY_E",       # end-of-wave age (precise)
  "R14MSTAT",
  "R14WORK",
  "R14SMOKEN",
  "R14DRINKD",
  "R14VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2018 <- nm_10[toupper(cov_req_2018)]
cov_actual_2018 <- cov_actual_2018[!is.na(cov_actual_2018)]

hrs_cov_2018 <- df_10 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn      = .data[[id_var_10]],
    year        = year,
    birth_year  = .data[[ byear_var_10 ]],
    birth_month = .data[[ bmon_var_10 ]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2018))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_2018 = coalesce(
      as.numeric(R14AGEY_E),
      if_else(!is.na(birth_year), as.numeric(year - birth_year), NA_real_)
    ),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Marital_status = case_when(
      R14MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R14MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R14WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R14WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R14SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R14SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R14DRINKD >  0 ~ 1L,
      R14DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R14VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R14VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2018,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )

# dementia (Langa-Weir 2018)
lw_2018 <- hrs_LangaWeir %>%
  filter(interview2018 == 1) %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = 1000 * as.numeric(hhid) + as.numeric(pn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    year        = 2018L,
    cogfunction = cogfunction2018,
    cogtot27    = cogtot27_imp2018
  )
```
