```{r}
# FAT 2018 file
fat_path_18 <- file.path(repo_root, "data/HRS/h18f2c_STATA/h18f2c.dta")

fat18 <- read_dta(
  fat_path_18,
  col_select = c(hhidpn,
                 qc104, qc087,                                     # pain, incontinence
                 qc095, qc096, qc097, qc098, qc101, qc102, qc103,  # sensory (includes hearing_aid)
                 qg086, qb082, qg198))                              # social activity

## Pain & incontinence
fat_pain_incont_2018 <- fat18 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    pain_2018 = case_when(
      qc104 == 1 ~ 1,
      qc104 == 5 ~ 0,
      qc104 > 5  ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    incont_2018 = case_when(
      qc087 == 1 ~ 1,
      qc087 == 5 ~ 0,
      qc087 > 5  ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

## Sensory (FAT)
sensory_2018 <- fat18 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      qc103 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      qc103 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      qc103 %in% c(8, 9)    ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hearing_aid = case_when(
      qc102 == 1         ~ 1L,
      qc102 == 5         ~ 0L,
      qc102 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_overall = case_when(
      qc095 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      qc095 %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,
      qc095 %in% c(8, 9)    ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_far = case_when(
      qc095 == 6            ~ 1L,      # legally blind → impaired
      qc096 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      qc096 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      qc096 %in% c(8, 9)    ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    vision_near = case_when(
      qc095 == 6            ~ 1L,      # legally blind → impaired
      qc097 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      qc097 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      qc097 %in% c(8, 9)    ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      qc098 == 1         ~ 1L,
      qc098 == 5         ~ 0L,
      qc098 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(qc098)       ~ 0L,         # skip-pattern: not diagnosed → no surgery
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    glaucoma_treatment = case_when(
      qc101 == 1         ~ 1L,
      qc101 == 5         ~ 0L,
      qc101 %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(qc101)       ~ 0L,         # skip-pattern: not diagnosed → no treatment
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Social activity (FAT)
social_2018 <- fat18 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn),

    volunteer = case_when(
      qg086 == 1 ~ 1L,
      qg086 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    religious_freq = case_when(
      qb082 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      qb082 %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      qb082 %in% c(8, 9)    ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    helping = case_when(
      qg198 == 1 ~ 1L,
      qg198 == 5 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Social_activity = case_when(
      volunteer == 1 | religious_freq == 1 | helping == 1 ~ 1L,
      is.na(volunteer) & is.na(religious_freq) & is.na(helping) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Social_activity)

## Frailty Index
fi_vars_req_2018    <- paste0("R", wave, fi_stems)
fi_vars_actual_2018 <- nm_10[fi_vars_req_2018]
fi_vars_actual_2018 <- fi_vars_actual_2018[!is.na(fi_vars_actual_2018)]

hrs_fi_2018 <- df_10 %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn = .data[[id_var_10]],
    across(all_of(fi_vars_actual_2018))     # named vector → renames to uppercase keys
  )

prefix <- paste0("R", wave)

hrs_fi_18 <- hrs_fi_2018 %>%
  mutate(
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility — code 7 ("don't do") treated as deficit
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0            ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4)    ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2018 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_18 <- hrs_fi_18 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2018, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2018 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_18), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2018 <- length(fi_items_2018)
cutoff_2018  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2018)

hrs_fi_18_valid <- hrs_fi_18 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2018))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2018) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2018)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2018_orig <- hrs_fi_18_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Same ≥0.25 threshold and ≥80% completeness rule, reapplied
#     to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2018 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2018_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2018, iadl_vars_2018)

n_items_2018_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2018_noIADL)
cutoff_2018_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2018_noIADL)

hrs_fi_18_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_18 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2018_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2018_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2018_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2018_noIADL <- hrs_fi_18_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2018_final <- hrs_fi_2018_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2018_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")
```

```{r}
# 6. Merge 2018 data
hrs_2018 <- hrs_cov_2018 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2018,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2018,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2018 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2018_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2018,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))


# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
imp18 <- hrs_2018 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender,
    age_2018 = as.numeric(age_2018),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity,
             Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)))

# Define imputation methods
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race previously had method "" while remaining
# in the predictor matrix, so mice never filled their missing cells and NAs were
# fed into every imputation model. They are now imputed INSIDE the FCS but are
# NOT carried back (imputed_vars below excludes them), so the analysis data
# keeps its original Gender and Race, including missing values.
meth <- make.method(imp18)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2018"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp18)) == 0] <- ""

# Predictor matrix
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp18)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete18 <- names(imp18)[colSums(is.na(imp18)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete18] != ""))

# Run MICE
set.seed(18)
imp_mice18 <- mice(
  imp18,
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp18_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice18, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2018")

hrs18_clean <- hrs_2018 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp18_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2018 <- hrs18_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
byear_var_11 <- nm_11["RABYEAR"]

if (any(is.na(c(id_var_11, byear_var_11, bmon_var_11))))
  stop("ID or birth variables missing (2020).")

cov_req_2020 <- c(
  "RAGENDER",
  "RAEDUC",
  "RARACEM",
  "RAHISPAN",
  "R15AGEY_E",       # end-of-wave age (precise)
  "R15MSTAT",
  "R15WORK",
  "R15SMOKEN",
  "R15DRINKD",
  "R15VGACTX"
)

cov_actual_2020 <- cov_actual_2020[!is.na(cov_actual_2020)]

hrs_cov_2020 <- df_11 %>%

    birth_month = .data[[bmon_var_11]],
    across(all_of(cov_actual_2020))
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    age_2020 = coalesce(
      as.numeric(R15AGEY_E),
      if_else(!is.na(birth_year), as.numeric(year - birth_year), NA_real_)
    ),

    Gender = case_when(
      RAGENDER %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(RAGENDER),
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: HS grad (3) belongs with HS tier, not college
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(RAEDUC)       ~ NA_integer_,
      RAEDUC == 1         ~ 0L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      RAEDUC %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: include partnered/spouse-absent (codes 2, 3) as married/partnered
    Marital_status = case_when(
      R15MSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      R15MSTAT %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Employment = case_when(
      R15WORK == 1 ~ 1L,
      R15WORK == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(
      R15SMOKEN == 1 ~ 1L,
      R15SMOKEN == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Alcohol = case_when(
      R15DRINKD >  0 ~ 1L,
      R15DRINKD == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # FIX: NH White still classified when RAHISPAN missing
    Race = case_when(
      (RAHISPAN == 0 | is.na(RAHISPAN)) & RARACEM == 1 ~ 0L,
      RAHISPAN == 1 | RARACEM %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      R15VGACTX %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      R15VGACTX %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hhidpn, year, birth_year, birth_month, age_2020,
    Gender, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
    Race, Physical_activity
  )
```

```{r}
    # ADL/IADL/Mobility — code 7 ("don't do") treated as deficit
    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c(
      "DRESS","BATH","EAT","BED","TOILT","WALKR",
      "WALK1","WALKS","CLIM1","LIFT","CHAIR","STOOP","DIME","ARMS",
      "PHONE","MONEY","MEALS","SHOP","MEDS"
    ))),
    ~ case_when(.x == 0            ~ 0,
                .x %in% c(1, 2, 7) ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("HIBP","DIAB","CANCR","ARTHR","LUNG","HEART"))),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4) ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "STROK")),
           ~ case_when(.x %in% c(0, 4)    ~ 0,
                       .x %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "SHLT")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 2 ~ 0.25,
                       .x == 3 ~ 0.50,
                       .x == 4 ~ 0.75,
                       .x == 5 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, c("SLEEPR","DEPRES","EFFORT","FLONE","FSAD","GOING"))),
           ~ case_when(.x == 0 ~ 0,
                       .x == 1 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    across(any_of(paste0(prefix, "ENLIFE")),
           ~ case_when(.x == 1 ~ 0,
                       .x == 0 ~ 1,
                       TRUE ~ NA_real_)),

    underweight_2020 = if (paste0(prefix, "BMI") %in% names(.)) {
      case_when(.data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] < 18.5  ~ 1,
                .data[[paste0(prefix, "BMI")]] >= 18.5 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_)
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

hrs_fi_20 <- hrs_fi_20 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(fat_pain_incont_2020, by = "hhidpn")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index (all items)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_items_2020 <- setdiff(names(hrs_fi_20), c("hhidpn", paste0(prefix, "BMI")))

n_items_2020 <- length(fi_items_2020)
cutoff_2020  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2020)

hrs_fi_20_valid <- hrs_fi_20 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2020))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items >= cutoff_2020) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2020)), na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score      = fi_n_deficits / fi_n_items
  )

hrs_fi_2020_orig <- hrs_fi_20_valid %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status = if_else(FI_score >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score, Frailty_status)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Same ≥0.25 threshold and ≥80% completeness rule, reapplied
#     to the reduced item set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
iadl_vars_2020 <- paste0(prefix, iadl_stems)

fi_items_2020_noIADL <- setdiff(fi_items_2020, iadl_vars_2020)

n_items_2020_noIADL <- length(fi_items_2020_noIADL)
cutoff_2020_noIADL  <- ceiling(0.80 * n_items_2020_noIADL)

hrs_fi_20_valid_noIADL <- hrs_fi_20 %>%
  mutate(fi_n_items_noIADL =
           rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(fi_items_2020_noIADL))))) %>%
  filter(fi_n_items_noIADL >= cutoff_2020_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_deficits_noIADL = rowSums(across(all_of(fi_items_2020_noIADL)),
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    FI_score_noIADL      = fi_n_deficits_noIADL / fi_n_items_noIADL
  )

hrs_fi_2020_noIADL <- hrs_fi_20_valid_noIADL %>%
  mutate(Frailty_status_noIADL = if_else(FI_score_noIADL >= 0.25, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, FI_score_noIADL, Frailty_status_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hrs_fi_2020_final <- hrs_fi_2020_orig %>%
  full_join(hrs_fi_2020_noIADL, by = "hhidpn")

```




```{r}
# 6. Merge 2020 data
hrs_2020 <- hrs_cov_2020 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  left_join(
    sensory_2020,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_2020,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    lw_2020 %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = c("hhidpn", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hrs_fi_2020_final %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fat_pain_incont_2020,
    by = "hhidpn"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dementia = if_else(cogfunction == 3, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_))


# 7. Imputation (consistent with ELSA approach)
imp20 <- hrs_2020 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    Gender,
    age_2020 = as.numeric(age_2020),
    Education = ordered(Education),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c(0, 1)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity,
             Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)))

# Define imputation methods
# FIX (specification): Gender and Race previously had method "" while remaining
# in the predictor matrix, so mice never filled their missing cells and NAs were
# fed into every imputation model. They are now imputed INSIDE the FCS but are
# NOT carried back (imputed_vars below excludes them), so the analysis data
# keeps its original Gender and Race, including missing values.
meth <- make.method(imp20)
meth["hhidpn"]    <- ""              # ID: never imputed
meth["age_2020"]  <- "pmm"
meth["Education"] <- "polr"
meth[c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
       "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth[colSums(is.na(imp20)) == 0] <- ""

# Predictor matrix
pred <- make.predictorMatrix(imp20)
pred[, "hhidpn"] <- 0
pred["hhidpn", ] <- 0

# GUARD: an incomplete variable must never be used as a predictor unless it is
# itself imputed, or mice feeds NAs into every imputation model.
incomplete20 <- names(imp20)[colSums(is.na(imp20)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth[incomplete20] != ""))

# Run MICE
set.seed(20)
imp_mice20 <- mice(
  imp20,
  m = 20,
  maxit = 10,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

# Extract completed dataset and merge back
imp20_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice20, 1)

imputed_vars <- c("Education", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking", "Alcohol",
                  "Physical_activity", "Social_activity", "age_2020")

hrs20_clean <- hrs_2020 %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp20_complete1 %>%
      mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
      dplyr::select(hhidpn, all_of(imputed_vars)),
    by = "hhidpn"
  )


# 8. Compute impaired_vision (no filtering — all NAs preserved)
HRS_2020 <- hrs20_clean %>%
  mutate(
    impaired_vision = pmax(
      coalesce(cataract_surgery, 0L),
      coalesce(glaucoma_treatment, 0L)
    )
  )
    
```
